name: Tragedy
description: '''Tragedy''' is an American [[crust punk]] band formed in 1999 in [[Memphis, Tennessee]], and later based in [[Portland, Oregon]]. Its members have also played in [[His Hero Is Gone]], [[From Ashes Rise]], and Severed Head of State. The band has released its records primarily through its own label, Tragedy Records, including the album ''Darker Days Ahead'' (2012) and the EP ''Fury'' (2018).
